نعتدي (form VIII)
# نَعْتَدِي (naʕtadī) /naʕ.ta.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# نَعْتَدِيَ (naʕtadiya) /naʕ.ta.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
